Over the next few years, that commercial transaction transcended into an implausible, emotional bond. While his former colleague Zaheer Khan will strategise, plan and manage the outfit as its newly appointed head coach, Dhoni will do Dhoni things — keep his door always open for a chat, offer a comforting shoulder to cry on, crack a silly joke to lighten the mood and whisper an invaluable nugget of insight that will make a player better.

triggers.detailsText: CARE Ratings Ltd reserves the right to revise/reaffirm/withdraw the rating assigned as also revise the outlook, as a result of periodic review/surveillance, based on any event or information which in the opinion of CARE Ratings Ltd warrants such an action. Our ratings do not factor in any rating related trigger clauses as per the terms of the facility/instrument, which may involve acceleration of payments in case of rating downgrades. However, if any such clauses are introduced and if triggered, the ratings may see volatility and sharp downgrades.
filingKeyFacts: CARE Ratings Ltd reserves the right to revise/reaffirm/withdraw the rating assigned as also revise the outlook, as a result of periodic review/surveillance, based on any event or information which in the opinion of CARE Ratings Ltd warrants such an action.
Our ratings do not factor in any rating related trigger clauses as per the terms of the facility/instrument, which may involve acceleration of payments in case of rating downgrades.
However, if any such clauses are introduced and if triggered, the ratings may see volatility and sharp downgrades.

triggers.riskNote: Read the complete rating rationale; reaffirmation may still include a negative outlook or elevated leverage.
